items.name: auth-001
items.title: Вход
items.description: Вход: подсказки autocomplete для менеджеров паролей, «забыли пароль» рядом с полем, вход через сервисы под формой.
items.docs:
Составной блок: импортирует button-001, button-077, checkbox-001, heading-001, input-001 из @/components/vibeui/ — команда установки приносит их вместе с блоком. Блок владеет раскладкой и своим текстом, частям передаёт только пропсы, их палитры --vibeui-<name>-* не трогает.

Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без npm-зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-auth-001-*. Серверный: хуков нет. Поля объявлены autoComplete="username" и "current-password", поэтому менеджер паролей подставляет данные. Разделитель перед входом через сервисы собран гридом, а не фоном под словом.

A composite block: imports button-001, button-077, checkbox-001, heading-001, input-001 from @/components/vibeui/ — the install command brings them along with the block. The block owns the layout and its own text, passes the parts props only and leaves their --vibeui-<name>-* palettes alone.

en.description: Sign-up with deliberate consent: the button waits for the required checkbox, marketing is off by default, and the terms open in place.

ai.summary: A sign-up form with a consent block: name, company, email, password, a required terms checkbox and a separate one for emails. Zero dependencies, one file.

the local --vibeui-auth-009-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the button disabled until the required box is ticked: consent must be an action, not fine print under a button
the marketing box unchecked by default: a pre-ticked one is unlawful in the EU and simply dishonest
opening the terms in place via <details>: leaving by link loses the filled-in form
keeping required and optional consent apart — one checkbox for everything is not consent
the hint line under the button: a disabled button with no explanation reads as a bug
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

the set of form fields, the field labels and the text inside details
the accent through the accent prop

This is an interface demo: the form stores nothing — registration is the caller's job.
Record the fact and time of consent on the server: a client-side checkbox proves nothing.
Have the terms copy reviewed by a lawyer — the wording here is a placeholder.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the block has to stay a single file.

en.docs:
A composite block: imports button-001, checkbox-001, heading-001, input-001 from @/components/vibeui/ — the install command brings them along with the block. The block owns the layout and its own text, passes the parts props only and leaves their --vibeui-<name>-* palettes alone.

The block is self-contained: one file, no npm dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-auth-009-*. A client component: "use client" is there for tying the consent checkbox to the button state. The full text of the terms sits in a <details> so as not to lead away from the page; the hint line under the button is marked role="status".

Составной блок: импортирует button-001, button-077, heading-001, input-001 из @/components/vibeui/ — команда установки приносит их вместе с блоком. Блок владеет раскладкой и своим текстом, частям передаёт только пропсы, их палитры --vibeui-<name>-* не трогает.

Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без npm-зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-auth-010-*. Клиентский: "use client" ради обратного отсчёта на useState и useEffect с setTimeout. Правая колонка со списком шагов скрывается целиком на узкой ширине через контейнерный запрос, номера шагов рисует counter, а не разметка.

preserve: the button-001, button-077, heading-001, input-001 imports from @/components/vibeui/ — do not inline their code into the block or swap in your own; the parts receive props only
the local --vibeui-auth-010-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the "what happens next" column: without the sender and the link's lifetime, a slow email reads as a broken service
hiding the steps column on narrow widths instead of squeezing it — a cropped list is worse than none
the countdown on the button: five taps produce five links, only the last of which works
the "if the address is registered" wording: otherwise the form probes other people's emails
numbering the steps with a CSS counter rather than hand-typed digits
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself
adapt: title, lead and submit

the accent through the accent prop

This is an interface demo: no email is sent — delivery and single-use links are the caller's job.
A client timer is defeated by a page reload — keep the real limit on the server.
Never print "email not found": that is a ready list of valid addresses.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the block has to stay a single file.

en.title: Reset Steps

props.title: Reset password
props.lead: We will email a link to the address you signed up with.
steps: The email comes from robot@vibeui.com — check Promotions and spam.
The link inside is single-use and lives for one hour.
The old password stops working the moment you change it.
Every active session on other devices ends.
props.sentTemplate: If that address is registered, the email has already been sent. You can send it again in {left} s.
props.back: Remembered it — back to sign in
